text: Though an army encamp against me, My heart will not fear; Though war arise against me, Even in this I am confident.
And now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me, In His tent I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.
Although my father and my mother have abandoned me, Yet the LORD will take me up [adopt me as His child].
Wait for and confidently expect the LORD; Be strong and let your heart take courage; Yes, wait for and confidently expect the LORD.
